query: SELECT h.id, h.ssh_host AS name FROM repo_hosts h JOIN machines hm ON hm.id = h.machine_id WHERE (hm.intermittent = true OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule_machine_wake w WHERE w.schedule_id = $1 AND w.machine_id = h.machine_id AND w.mode = 'wait')) AND h.id IN (SELECT r.repo_host_id FROM schedule_repos sr JOIN repos r ON r.id = sr.repo_id WHERE sr.schedule_id = $1) ORDER BY h.ssh_host
